cases.requirement: Carry signed offers/answers through intended invited routes only.
cases.pass_rule: Oversize SDP, expired replay, arbitrary destination URL and unsolicited broadcast rejected.

cases.requirement: Keep private room discovery opaque and permission-scoped.
cases.pass_rule: No private names, memberships, candidate SDP or content exported to public directory/logs.

cases.requirement: Handle steward restart and seed loss with bounded jittered retry.
cases.pass_rule: RAM lease loss is visible; no reconnect storm or fake availability.

cases.requirement: Keep support processes separate from origin identity and host files.
cases.pass_rule: Ordinary posts bypass codiauth; role credentials cannot read host paths or issue account certificates.

cases.requirement: Bind one reviewed group-key profile/library and documented trust boundary.
cases.pass_rule: Private routed UI remains blocked until this gate; raw per-hop DTLS never mislabeled as relay-private.

cases.requirement: Authenticate control epochs and membership independently of routing cells.
cases.pass_rule: Cell migration cannot grant membership or reuse wrong-epoch private data.

cases.requirement: Test add/remove/rekey and pre/post-removal traffic.
cases.pass_rule: Removed member cannot read/publish new canonical epoch content; overlap does not revive grants.

cases.requirement: Define honest partition behavior without automatic competing canonical key schedules.
cases.pass_rule: Controller loss blocks canonical membership changes; optional new groups have distinct IDs.

cases.requirement: Test join/leave storms, lost key updates and bounded catch-up.
cases.pass_rule: Memory/CPU/key material/history buffers capped; unavailable keys fail clearly.

cases.requirement: Separate identity, authorization, secrecy and truth in UI/protocol.
cases.pass_rule: Valid signature cannot create privileges or validate a false game result; expired identity not silently downgraded.

cases.requirement: Implement hash-addressed binary chunks and trusted publisher binding.
cases.pass_rule: Wrong bytes rejected; untrusted but hash-correct code never executed automatically.

cases.requirement: Keep ephemeral ANON data in memory by default.
cases.pass_rule: Reload/logout clears user state; opting into public asset cache does not persist identity or chat.

cases.requirement: Enforce bytes, count, quota, TTL and pin budgets.
cases.pass_rule: Pinned-full/eviction/quota denial returns capacity; no silent reliable data loss promise.

cases.requirement: Advertise only held verified chunks and withdraw on expiry/eviction.
cases.pass_rule: Disappeared provider or partial chunk retries within a bound; no fake successful fetch.

cases.requirement: Implement explicit retained ciphertext leases and bounded offline mailbox scope.
cases.pass_rule: No origin chat storage; lost replicas and expiry visible; remote erasure not promised.

cases.requirement: Measure bulk fairness while chat/game/control are active.
cases.pass_rule: Large model/guest/image transfer remains chunked; controls meet recorded latency targets.

cases.requirement: Use bounded directory lookups among provisioned stable stewards.
cases.pass_rule: No global enumeration; parallelism/work/wall-time caps enforced on adversarial replies.

cases.requirement: Assign members to bounded discovery/delivery cells without full mesh.
cases.pass_rule: Peer degree stays capped while cell membership increases; hot-key metrics recorded.

cases.requirement: Sequence split descriptors with finite migration overlap.
cases.pass_rule: Duplicate path deliveries deduplicate; stale split/grant rejected and old routes expire.

cases.requirement: Prove replica/failure-domain accounting and single-writer fencing policy.
cases.pass_rule: Same-host replicas not counted independent; controller fork stops changes visibly.

cases.requirement: Merge only with hysteresis and preserve room/content IDs.
cases.pass_rule: Rapid threshold oscillation does not cause endless resharding or lose acknowledged events.

cases.requirement: Expose large-room semantics instead of hiding fan-out.
cases.pass_rule: Announcement recipients receive every accepted announcement; separate conversations have distinct visible IDs.

cases.requirement: Create per-match groups separate from lobby/parent chat.
cases.pass_rule: Unrelated spectators/rooms do not receive input/state unless explicitly subscribed.

cases.requirement: Separate reliable actions/checkpoints from expiring latest-state updates.
cases.pass_rule: Packet loss does not queue obsolete positions indefinitely; commands remain attributable.

cases.requirement: Define game authority and result validation rather than trusting signatures.
cases.pass_rule: Signed impossible race/board state rejected by rules/replay or labeled unverified.

cases.requirement: Constrain apps/guest bridges to scoped capabilities.
cases.pass_rule: Peer messages and game scripts cannot invoke host files, guest shell or authority signing.

cases.requirement: Publish bounded-rate spectator snapshots separately.
cases.pass_rule: Spectator growth cannot silently expand player mesh or tick broadcast denominator.

cases.requirement: Choose measurable per-game latency and migration rules.
cases.pass_rule: Controller departure pauses/reconciles or ends match honestly; no global deterministic realtime promise.

cases.requirement: Prove direct and relay-only connections across distinct real networks.
cases.pass_rule: Record actual candidate types; blocked NAT without relay fails rather than HTTP chat fallback.

cases.requirement: Freeze/discard/sleep/restart browsers while rooms are active.
cases.pass_rule: Leases expire and peers repair; resumed browser revalidates before live sends.

cases.requirement: Inject whole-steward/operator loss and split networks.
cases.pass_rule: Report reachable recipient denominator, lost history, authority outage and recovery work.

cases.requirement: Exercise Sybil/eclipse/spam threats with capped admission and diverse provisioned support.
cases.pass_rule: No claim that certificates/peer scores prove unique humans or defeat arbitrary adversaries.

cases.requirement: Test relay privacy and traffic quotas.
cases.pass_rule: Application relay cannot read private payload; TURN/forwarding limits prevent open-proxy abuse.

cases.requirement: Test reordered, duplicated, delayed and forged packets at scale.
cases.pass_rule: No unverified cache poisoning/replay-state advance; logs bounded and redact sensitive data.

cases.requirement: Run real groups at 2/8/32 peers within available hardware and state exact topology.
cases.pass_rule: Missing hardware capacity is blocked, not fabricated; actual separate processes distinguished from simulation.

cases.requirement: Run event simulations at 1k/10k/100k with realistic skew/churn scenarios.
cases.pass_rule: Report modeled mechanisms/omissions; ideal graph toy does not count as distributed-protocol proof.

cases.requirement: Measure CPU, memory, bytes, queue depth, retransmits and p50/p95/p99 latency.
cases.pass_rule: Published denominators include all admitted jobs/recipients, losses and failed reconnects.

cases.requirement: Project 10^10 population with explicit online fraction, room mix and relay rate.
cases.pass_rule: Analytical result labeled extrapolation; no ten-billion live test claimed.

cases.requirement: Demonstrate offered load below measured forwarding capacity or enforce refusal.
cases.pass_rule: Constrained/noncontributing users cannot create an unfunded perpetual relay/storage commitment.

cases.requirement: Falsify root/global-hotspot assumptions.
cases.pass_rule: Root disconnect leaves valid local groups independent; hot discovery key overload triggers sharding/refusal not global scan.

cases.requirement: Prepare process/key/state layout for box-webhost and delegated peers.
cases.pass_rule: Origin, stewardship, TURN and owner broker separated; no public deployment without authorization.

cases.requirement: Pin binaries/dependencies and rotate scoped keys with rollback protection.
cases.pass_rule: Compromised/revoked service key fails after its authority lifetime; no issuer secret in peer assets.

cases.requirement: Run small public pilot with limits and privacy-preserving telemetry.
cases.pass_rule: Track failure domains and real bandwidth/connection capacity; no generic global analytics beacon.

cases.requirement: Practice draining/rehome/backup/restore of assigned portions.
cases.pass_rule: Signed descriptor change works without client code rewrite; immutable source remains recoverable.

cases.requirement: Verify authority outage/expiry and disaster recovery.
cases.pass_rule: No fabricated freshness, automatic trust downgrade or indefinitely live revoked authority.

cases.requirement: Publish evidence ledger and only expand after declared thresholds.
cases.pass_rule: Passed/failed/blocked/assumed/model-only statuses remain separate; no scale claim from artifact count.
